newsitem.title: JAPAN: DOLLAR SUPPORTED IN TOKYO, WATCHING NIKKEI.
newsitem.headline: DOLLAR SUPPORTED IN TOKYO, WATCHING NIKKEI.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be well-supported in Asia on Tuesday following its recovery in New York overnight, dealers said.

Market participants will be closely watching activity in Japanese stocks after the Nikkei fell sharply on Monday. The dollar is expected to receive additional support against the yen if the Nikkei share average falls again today, they said.

"Japanese stocks are likely to recover after watching the rises in the Wall Street overnight. But the dollar should be well-bid against the yen if and when Japanese stocks start declining," a Japanese trust bank dealer said.
Dealers expect to see the dollar move in tight ranges against the mark in Asia.

The market will be looking at the Bundesbank's weekly money market operation on Tuesday, they said. Before adjourning in July for its four-week summer recess, the Bundesbank fanned speculation that it might allow its fixed repo rate to float to stem the mark's steady decline.
The dollar is seen moving in a range of 1.8620 to 1.8720 marks in Asia.
